pay_cost_of_living_007.evidence: Effective July 1, 2016, all Certificated Salary Schedules shall be increased by three and one-half percent (3.5%). Effective July 1, 2017, all Certificated Salary Schedule shall be increased by two percent (2.0%). Effective July 1, 2018, all Certificated Salary Schedules shall be increased by one percent (1%).

pay_extra_duty_schedule_008.evidence: The EPES schedules shall be increased by the same percentage as applies to schedules effective July 1 of the following year. The extra pay amounts set forth on the EPES Additional Service Pay Schedule (i.e. pp. 110-119 in the 2010-2012 CBA) shall double with the exception of elementary athletic coaches which will triple.
